title: Guardrail
line: Ask before a risky command runs.

beats.caption: You ask for a quick fix and a push.
The agent fixes the typo and runs the test.
The fix stays in your local checkout.

takeaway.title: You decide what runs
takeaway.line: Review the command before it changes the remote.

title.text: A quick fix can end with a command you'd rather review yourself. Guardrail gives you that moment.
title.spoken: A quick fix can end with a command you'd rather review yourself. Guardrail gives you that moment.

scene.text: You ask for a small typo fix. The test passes, then the agent reaches for a force push. Guardrail brings that command to you for a decision. You turn it down, and the fix stays in your checkout.
scene.spoken: You ask for a small typo fix. The test passes, then the agent reaches for a force push. Guardrail brings that command to you for a decision. You turn it down, and the fix stays in your checkout.

takeaway.text: Read the command while you can still decide. A local fix can wait until you've reviewed how it ships.
takeaway.spoken: Read the command while you can still decide. A local fix can wait until you've reviewed how it ships.
